description: CHRONEX-US: City-level historical road network expansion dataset for the conterminous United States is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Johannes H. Uhl, Keith A. Burghardt. Geospatial datasets on the long-term evolution of road networks are scarce, hampering our quantitative understanding of how the contemporary road network has evolved over the course of the 20 th century. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2698575264 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
